title: PackageResult
description: Where the package landed and what it claims. A summary of the committed ContentPackage — the artefact under `packages/<id>/package.json` is the record; this is what a caller prints.

packagePath.description: Job-relative path to the package DIRECTORY, e.g. `packages/<contentPackageId>`.

releaseState.description: REQ-105, computed. The two states Phase 0 can substantiate; `publish_ready` and `published` are not emitted, so they are not members here either.

warningWaiverCount.description: Counted separately from the gate status because D-35 requires waived packages to be reportable apart from clean ones.

files.description: Package-relative names of every file in the delivered directory, so a caller can verify the bundle without opening it.
